feeDetail.note: Richland Public Health licensing fees vary by food operation risk level, facility type, and applicable Ohio state fee.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Ross County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Ross County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license before operating.

feeDetail.note: Ross County food-license fees vary by operation type and risk classification; contact the health district for the current schedule.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Sandusky County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Sandusky County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and comply with local inspection and renewal requirements.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by operation category and risk level under the Sandusky County Health Department schedule.

penalty.note: Ohio law requires a 25% penalty of the renewal fee when the fee is late.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Scioto County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Scioto County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license before operating.

feeDetail.note: Published 2025 local license fees range from $65.50 mobile low-risk to $1,000 for large risk-level-4 commercial facilities; fees vary by risk category and size.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Seneca County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Seneca County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license; temporary operations require a separate temporary food license.

feeDetail.note: The county’s current temporary food license fee is $80; other license fees vary by operation and risk classification.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Shelby County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Shelby County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license before operating.

feeDetail.note: Shelby City's published schedule lists local food fees of $120-$415 by risk class and facility size, plus current state fees.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain a Stark County vendor license
items.description: A business selling products from a fixed place of business in Stark County must obtain the regular county vendor license; the application fee is $50 and there is no annual renewal fee.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: File the Summit County lodging tax return
items.authority: Summit County Fiscal Office, Lodging Excise Tax Department
items.description: The tax is 5.5%. Lodging establishments mail each month's return with payment to the Lodging Excise Tax Department in Akron; the page read does not state the day of the month. The lodging registration form is due by January 31 each year. Phone 330-643-2437.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Ohio has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Summit.

items.title: Obtain a Trumbull County vendor license
items.description: Every Ohio retailer making taxable retail sales in Trumbull County must obtain a vendor license; the current application fee is $50.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Trumbull County food license
items.description: Food businesses operating in Trumbull County must obtain the applicable food service or retail food establishment license before operating; the local health district issues the license under Ohio food-safety rules.

feeDetail.note: Fees depend on the food operation and risk category.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Tuscarawas County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Tuscarawas County must obtain the applicable annual license before operating and renew it by March 1 or before seasonal/mobile operations begin.

feeDetail.note: 2026 fees vary by risk level, square footage, mobile/temporary status, and plan review.

penalty.note: 25% of the local fee for late renewal.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Union County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Union County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license before operating and renew it by March 1 each year.

feeDetail.note: Published fees range from $11.82 plus state fee for vending to $1,248 plus state fee for level-4 commercial operations over 25,000 square feet; expedited plan review adds $1,000.

penalty.note: Ohio food-license renewals incur a 25% penalty of the applicable renewal fee when late.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Van Wert County food license
items.authority: Van Wert County General Health District
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Van Wert County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and comply with county inspection and renewal requirements; temporary events require an application at least seven days in advance.

feeDetail.note: License fees vary by operation category and risk level; the county requires the applicable fee with the food-license application.

penalty.note: Ohio food-license renewals incur a 25% penalty of the applicable renewal fee when late.

items.title: Obtain and renew the applicable food establishment license
items.description: Food establishments operating in this jurisdiction must obtain the applicable state or local food license before operating and renew it as required.

feeDetail.note: The county guide states license fees range from $195-$855; plan review begins at $100 plus hourly review and inspection time.

penalty.note: The county application states a mandatory 25% penalty of the renewal fee for operating after the deadline.

items.title: Obtain a Warren County vendor license
items.description: Businesses making taxable retail sales or providing taxable services in Warren County must obtain the applicable vendor license; a regular license has a $50 application fee.

appliesWhen.description: Makes taxable retail sales or provides taxable services

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Warren County food license
items.description: Food service operations in Warren County must obtain the applicable annual license; the county publishes risk-based fees and assesses a late fee of 25% of the local fee after March 1.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a food service operation or retail food establishment

penalty.note: 25% of the local fee for applications and payment postmarked after March 1.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Washington County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Washington County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and comply with county health department application, inspection, and fee requirements.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by operation category and are published in the county environmental fee schedule.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Wayne County food license
items.description: Food service operations, retail food establishments, mobile operations, temporary operations, and vending locations operating in Wayne County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and renew it annually by March 1.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by Ohio risk classification and operation type.

penalty.note: Annual applications after February 1 are subject to a delinquency fee equal to double the regular fee.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Williams County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Williams County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and comply with local inspection and renewal requirements.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by operation category and risk level under the Williams County Health Department schedule.

penalty.note: Ohio law requires a 25% penalty of the renewal fee when the fee is late.

items.title: Obtain a Wood County vendor license
items.description: Businesses making taxable retail sales in Wood County must obtain an Ohio vendor license; the county auditor lists a $50 application fee and no annual renewal fee for a transient license.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Wood County food license
items.description: Food businesses serving or selling food to the public in Wood County must obtain the applicable local food license; the risk level determines the license fee.

feeDetail.note: The health department sets fees by risk level.

appliesWhen.description: Serves or sells food to the public

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Wyandot County food license
items.description: Food service operations and retail food establishments operating in Wyandot County must obtain the applicable Ohio food license and comply with local inspection and renewal requirements.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by operation category and risk level under the Wyandot County Public Health schedule.

penalty.note: Ohio law requires a 25% penalty of the renewal fee when the fee is late.
